multiplechoiceresponse.p: A user can ping the file server by IP address but not by its hostname. Which service is most likely failing?

div.p: If the IP works and the name does not, addressing and routing are fine and name resolution is broken — that is DNS.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which port is used by HTTPS?

div.p: HTTPS uses TCP 443. Port 80 is plain HTTP, 25 is SMTP, and 3389 is RDP.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: A device shows an address beginning with 169.254.. This means:

choice.div: It has a valid public address.
It failed to obtain an address from DHCP.
It has been assigned by the router successfully.

div.p: The 169.254.0.0/16 range is the link-local fallback used when DHCP gives no lease. Release and renew the address and check DHCP reachability.
